decision.rationale: 164 conversions vs 178 planned (-7.9%). Google underperformed by 12 conversions; CPC came in at €1.21 (vs €1.20 planned) — negligible variance. The shortfall came from Meta: actual conversion rate on Meta was 2.1% vs the planned 2.3%, yielding 82 conversions vs 86. ROAS 2.94× vs target 3.2×. Client target was 150 sales — exceeded by 14. Recommend flagging the Meta conversion rate gap for landing page A/B test in Q4.
